name: smwmusic-ooooo-the-bombastic-baron-bowser-the-final-battle
title: ooooo - The Bombastic Baron Bowser!! ~ The Final Battle
description:
𝓦𝓱𝓪𝓽'𝓼 𝓽𝓱𝓪𝓽, 𝓹𝓲𝓹𝓼𝓺𝓾𝓮𝓪𝓴?
𝓘𝓽'𝓼 𝓷𝓸𝓽 𝓼𝓽𝓮𝓪𝓵𝓲𝓷𝓰 𝓲𝓯 𝔂𝓸𝓾 𝓸𝔀𝓷 𝓽𝓱𝓮 𝓻𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓽𝓼!

Yes, ontop of being the main coder of the boss, I also ended up being the main composer too. what

The bombastic final battle against President "Baron" Bowser in JUMP Team's "ooooo". Fitting for boss fights where the villain stops messing around and gets personal.

This is definitely the song I put the most effort in. What was a song with 12 tracks thanks to a crazy amount of chords was compressed down to 8 (which funny enough is the case for all three of my main original tracks in ooooo). This track in particular will eat up a LOT of space to insert just from samples alone.

Featuring guest composer Wyatt helping with one of the melodies.

Not compatible with thunder, barggs, yoshi, p-switch, bonus end, or star.
